name: Face Off

features.name: Retriggers
features.description: Three scatters in the bonus add five spins.

review:
Halloween on the Bonanza engine: four masked maniacs lurking in a graveyard. Symbols pay anywhere with refills, and scatters pay whenever they land.

Tombstone multipliers only turn up in free spins, each worth 2x to 100x. Three more scatters in the bonus add five spins. High volatility, 15,000x max and 95.97% RTP. The bonus is rare – about once every 395 spins – so this one needs patience.
pros: Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Bonus is rare (about 1 in 395 spins on average)
